title: Bounded traversal
step_semantics: Each after-index state represents one true loop condition, one selected element and addition, then the increment before the next state. The opening and terminal states show the initial and final condition.
pause_behavior: Pause keeps the current state selected; this model never advances automatically.
accessible_summary: The trace visits indices 0 through 5 in order. Running totals are 12, 30, 39, 60, 75, and 99. The final condition is false at i = 6; no seventh element is selected.
reduced_motion_summary: Show the same ordered states and captions without animated movement.

citations.claim: The selected array element is evaluated through indexing as pointer addition and indirection.
The traversal must remain within the six-element array and stop at its one-past boundary.

states.caption: The condition 0 < 6 is true. No element has been added yet.
Index 0 selects 12. Add it once; the loop then advances to i = 1.
Index 1 selects 18. The running total is now 30.
Index 2 selects 9. The running total is now 39.
Index 3 selects 21. The running total is now 60.
Index 4 selects 15. The running total is now 75.
Index 5 selects 24. The running total is now 99.
After incrementing, i is 6. The condition is false, so the one-past position is not read.
